chunks: My group of scholars narrated to me from 'Abdullah ibn Ja'far Al-Himyari, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother 'Ali, from Al-Hasan ibn Sa'id, from Safwan ibn Yahya, Ibn Abi 'Umayr, and Fadalah ibn Ayyub, all from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to Ibn Abi Ya'fūr: 'Increase your prayers in the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), for he said: One prayer in my mosque here is equal to one thousand prayers in any other mosque, except for Al-Masjid Al-Harām, for one prayer in Al-Masjid Al-Harām is equal to one thousand prayers in my mosque.'

key_terms.مَسْجِدُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: Mosque of the Messenger of Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the reward multiplier for praying in the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah compared to other mosques?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the spiritual hierarchy of sacred spaces, positioning the Prophet's Mosque as second only to the Kaaba in Mecca. It reflects the Shia emphasis on the physical sanctity of the Ahl al-Bayt's resting places, where the reward of prayer is multiplied not merely by location but by the presence of the Prophet's legacy. The comparison underscores the unique status of Al-Masjid Al-Haram while affirming the profound merit of visiting and praying in Medina.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 4. All of my scholars narrated to me from ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari, from Ibrāhīm ibn Mahziyār, from his brother ‘Ali, from Ḥasan ibn Sa’īd, from Safwān ibn Yaḥyā, Ibn Abī ‘Umayr, and Faďālah ibn Ayyūb, from Mu’āwiyah ibn ‘Ammār, who said:

Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said to Ibn Abī Ya’fūr: Increasingly establish prayers in the Mosque of the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.), for the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) has said, “One Salāt in my mosque is equal to one thousand Salāt in any other mosque except Masjid Al-Ḥarām, for one Salāt in Masjid Al-Ḥarām is equal to one thousand Salāt in my mosque.”
